description: Audit a project in one call: send package-lock.json (v2/v3), package.json, composer.lock, composer.json or requirements.txt. Lockfiles give exact direct and transitive versions; manifest ranges are resolved to the highest satisfying version and labelled so; unpinned requirements are listed as unresolved. Returns every affected package with advisories, severity, fixed versions and the smallest fixing upgrade, plus coverage limits. Up to 300 packages per audit. Price: 0.025 USDC per call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base or Solana, no account, no API key); invalid input is refused before payment and a failed run is never charged. Without a payment the tool returns the x402 PaymentRequired. Free sample answer: get_example {"tool":"deps_audit_project"}. Same tool over HTTP: https://yruz.one/api/deps/audit?manifest=%7B%22dependencies%22%3A%7B%22express%22%3A%22%5E4.17.0%22%2C%22lodash%22%3A%224.17.15%22%2C%22minimist%22%3A%221.2.5%22%7D%7D
